episodes.title: Hello Yellow Brick Road
episodes.summary: Kate experiences the force of nature that is Tully when they meet as teens, at their first journalism jobs in 1982 and over a PTA crush in 2003.

episodes.title: Oh! Sweet Something
episodes.summary: A traumatic assault. A hidden romance. A signed consent form. Secrets both shared and unspoken test Kate and Tully's friendship over the years.

episodes.title: Dancing Queens
episodes.summary: Sneaking out to a school dance, breaking a news story and enjoying a hip-shaking night on the town, Tully and Kate whirl through life together.

episodes.title: Love is a Battlefield
episodes.summary: Tully and Kate weather health issues and romantic entanglements, from a college dalliance to a steamy encounter that leaves an ex hot under the collar.

episodes.title: Sweet Child O' Mine
episodes.summary: Tully's lie threatens the pair's friendship. Kate feels stressed over huge life changes. A treasured gift leads to a gut-wrenching goodbye.

episodes.title: Dirty Laundry
episodes.summary: The BFFs catch the attention of a school bully. Kate attempts to move on. Tully faces choices that could change her life personally and professionally.

episodes.title: Total Eclipse of the Hart
episodes.summary: Tully's mom disappoints her again and again, and Kate's boozy night with her best friend and their coworkers causes awkwardness, accusations and hurt.

episodes.title: Mawaige
episodes.summary: Vows are made and hearts broken as Kate navigates her long-strained relationship with her brother, and Tully grapples with compromise and commitment.

episodes.title: You Say It's Your Birthday?!
episodes.summary: After one of Tully's birthdays ends in disaster, Kate becomes devoted to making her friend's big day special, even if her efforts don't always succeed.

episodes.title: Auld Lang Syne
episodes.summary: Over holidays past and present, relationships shift — and truths are spoken — as Tully and Kate reshape their expectations for what the future holds.

episodes.title: Wish You Were Here
episodes.summary: Trying times bring Kate and Tully together as they contend with an overbearing grandma, a pesky new intern and an ex-husband in distress.

episodes.title: On the Road
episodes.summary: Over the decades and several road trips, Tully and Kate strengthen their bond and forge new relationships while occasionally testing them.

episodes.title: I'm Coming Out
episodes.summary: A teen magazine. A political investigation. A secret message. Shocking revelations lead to major questions for Sean, Tully and Kate.

episodes.title: Papa Don't Preach
episodes.summary: As Tully's career takes off, uncomfortable encounters at work keep throwing her off track. Johnny's behavior causes concern among his loved ones.

episodes.title: Simple Twist of Fate
episodes.summary: From a double date in 1975 to Tully's search for her father in 2004, Tully and Kate attempt to take charge of their futures — but fate has other plans.

episodes.title: Reborn on the Fourth of July
episodes.summary: While celebrating their own freedom on Independence Day, Tully and Kate learn time and again that relying on each other may not be so bad after all.

episodes.title: Good Riddance / Time of Your Life
episodes.summary: Tully attempts to face unresolved loose ends from her past. But her choices lead to a potentially unforgivable mistake that impacts Kate's life.

episodes.title: All Apologies
episodes.summary: Kate learns that dealing with an ex is always tricky, no matter the decade. After years of never saying sorry, Tully struggles with accountability.

episodes.title: Hart Shaped Box
episodes.summary: For the first time in decades, Kate and Tully experience a year apart — but can they handle major life events without each other?

episodes.title: All the World's a Stage
episodes.summary: Kate has often felt invisible next to Tully through the years. But amid major changes, Kate realizes she may need her best friend by her side.

episodes.title: The Breast Is Yet to Come
episodes.summary: From bra-stuffing to breastfeeding, Kate experiences several bumps in the road on her journey from a self-conscious teen to a first-time mother.

episodes.title: Time After Time
episodes.summary: Johnny and Kate reminisce at a party about a life-changing kiss in the same newsroom, 20 years earlier. Tully gives Danny advice on his love life.

episodes.title: Can't Fight This Feeling
episodes.summary: A bridal shower stirs up resentments and memories, an awkward encounter leads to a life-changing question, and a tragedy shakes teenage Kate's world.

episodes.title: I Can't Go On, I'll Go On
episodes.summary: Kate and Johnny's loved ones gather for two very different celebrations. Tully gets tangled in a romantic dilemma, and Kate feels the weight of a secret.

episodes.title: Moondance
episodes.summary: Tully, Johnny and Marah try to find ways of coping after Kate's revelation. In the 1980s, Johnny wrestles with another piece of overwhelming news.

episodes.title: This Must Be the Place
episodes.summary: On a special day for the Mularkey family, Tully reflects on decades of work, love, grief and joy alongside her best friend. Kate faces the unknown.
